_comment: Example collection-ad creative spec used by `apb creative create-collection --spec-file <this>`. Pass with --name to override the catalog-default name. The product_set_id under template_data points at a product set you've created via `apb catalog product-set-create`. Hero element is the lead asset (image_hash from `apb creative upload-image`, or video_id from `apb creative upload-video`); child_attachments are auto-filled by Meta from the product_set when omitted.
